proposals.evidence: DEDR3758 explicitly gives Kannada ninne and Gondi ninnē/ninne yesterday. These ninne/nenne/nenna/ninna/nanne survey responses retain the same yesterday stem with source vowel and ordinary final variants; larger clauses and Kannada menne are excluded. This is a comparative family proposal; inheritance versus local transmission in this survey lect remains subject to review.

Selected simple and ordinary tense/nominal forms retain that eat stem and its documented alternants; survey endings, voicing and vowels are preserved.
